fields.label: GTIN
fields.definition: A Global Trade Item Number (GTIN) is the 14 digit GS1 Identification Key used to identify products. The key comprises a GS1 Company Prefix followed by an Item Reference Number and a Check Digit. See https://www.gs1.org/gtin  for more details.
fields.tier_rationale: The GTIN identifies the model. It is stated explicitly rather than left to be read out of a SKU, because everything downstream — the Digital Link, the resolver, the passport itself — is keyed on it.

fields.label: modelIdentifier
fields.tier_rationale: The model this article belongs to, where the regulation names one.

fields.label: Batch/Lot Identifier
fields.definition: The batch or lot number associates an item with information the manufacturer considers relevant for traceability of the trade item to which the element string is applied. The data may refer to the trade item itself or to items contained. The number may be, for example, a production lot number, a shift number, a machine number, a time, or an internal production code. In cases where the same product is manufactured in different locations the brand owner and the manufacturer are responsible for ensuring the non-duplication of batch/lot numbers for a GTIN. For the re-use of batch/lot numbers with a GTIN, sector-specific constraints need to be considered.
fields.tier_rationale: The lot. Class data describes the model; a lot is where a passport stops being the same for every item.

fields.label: Collection Method
fields.definition: How the waste item entered separate collection (retailer take-back, municipal collection point, producer scheme pick-up, ...).
fields.tier_rationale: Which collection route one item took is take-back scheme operating data; the public tier carries the scheme itself via euelec:collectionSchemeUrl.

fields.label: Collection Scheme URL
fields.definition: URL to information about the WEEE collection/take-back scheme.
fields.tier_rationale: Dir. 2012/19/EU Art. 14 requires users to be informed about return and collection systems, so the scheme link must be public to serve its purpose.

fields.label: Component Part Number
fields.definition: Manufacturer's part number for the component.
fields.tier_rationale: Manufacturer part numbers reveal sourcing relationships and are professional repair/recycling detail.

fields.label: Data Wiped
fields.definition: Whether user data held on the device was securely erased before it was passed on for re-use or treatment.
fields.tier_rationale: Data-erasure assertions concern one device's handling before re-use and are evidence for the operator and the previous owner, not public product data.

fields.label: Device Condition
fields.definition: Condition of the device as assessed when it was taken in for collection or sorting.
fields.tier_rationale: The intake condition assessment is a treatment-operator judgement about one waste item (Dir. 2012/19/EU Art. 8), not product information.

fields.label: Display Technology
fields.definition: Display technology type (LCD, OLED, AMOLED, MicroLED, etc.).
fields.tier_rationale: The panel technology is ordinary public spec-sheet information.

fields.label: Energy Label URL
fields.definition: URL to the EU Energy Label image.
fields.tier_rationale: The energy-label image is itself a public label; EPREL serves it in its public part (Reg. (EU) 2017/1369 Art. 12(3)).

fields.label: eprelProductUrl
fields.tier_rationale: The EPREL product page is the public register entry itself (Reg. (EU) 2017/1369 Art. 12(3)).

fields.label: eprelRegistrationNumber
fields.tier_rationale: The EPREL registration number keys the public register entry and is visible in every public EPREL URL (Reg. (EU) 2017/1369 Art. 12(3)).

fields.label: Feature Update End Date
fields.definition: Date until which feature/OS updates will be provided.
fields.tier_rationale: The feature-update end date is the concrete form of the public update-support commitment.

fields.label: Firmware Version
fields.definition: Current version of the device firmware.
fields.tier_rationale: The current firmware version is device-state transparency a user can read from the device itself.

fields.label: hasAnnualEnergyConsumption
fields.tier_rationale: Annual energy consumption appears on the public energy label and product information sheet in EPREL (Reg. (EU) 2017/1369 Art. 12(3)); aligned with core oec:hasAnnualEnergyConsumption (Public).

fields.label: Avoided Emissions
fields.definition: Estimate of the greenhouse-gas emissions avoided by recovering materials from this item.
fields.tier_rationale: Avoided-emissions estimates are recycler claims about one treatment operation; unlike a substantiated product carbon footprint they are not verified label data, so they are not published by default.

fields.label: Battery Disposition
fields.definition: How the battery removed from the item was handled.
fields.tier_rationale: How the removed battery was handled is treatment-chain evidence for the selective-treatment duty (Dir. 2012/19/EU Annex VII).

fields.label: Bill of Materials
fields.definition: Component bill of materials for the device.
fields.tier_rationale: The component BOM is design and sourcing detail for repairers, recyclers and authorities with a legitimate interest, not consumer information.

fields.label: Component Passport
fields.tier_rationale: Links into nested component passports expose the component supply chain and are aimed at professional actors (CIRPASS-2 multi-component tracking).

fields.label: Component Type
fields.definition: Type of component (Battery, Display, etc.).
fields.tier_rationale: The component type (battery, display) names the part a public repair statement refers to, without exposing sourcing detail.

fields.label: Components
fields.definition: List of components in the bill of materials.
fields.tier_rationale: The component list is BOM content and shares the BOM's legitimate-interest tier.

fields.label: Display Specification
fields.definition: Display-specific technical specifications.
fields.tier_rationale: Display specifications are spec-sheet data, published in the public EPREL fiche for displays under Reg. (EU) 2019/2013.

fields.label: Energy Efficiency
fields.definition: EU Energy Label information.
fields.tier_rationale: The energy-label information container carries data that Reg. (EU) 2017/1369 puts on the public label and in the public part of EPREL.

fields.label: hasEnergyEfficiencyClass
fields.tier_rationale: The A-G energy class is printed on the public energy label and published in the public part of EPREL (Reg. (EU) 2017/1369 Art. 12(3)).

fields.label: Estimated Recoverable Materials
fields.definition: Material streams expected to be recoverable from the item, estimated before treatment.
fields.tier_rationale: Pre-treatment recoverability estimates are recycler planning data; the public tier carries the design-level recyclability and recoverable rates (oec:hasRecyclabilityAssessment).

fields.label: Feature Support Years
fields.definition: Number of years of feature update support. Use gs1:QuantitativeValue with unitCode 'ANN'.
fields.tier_rationale: The feature-update period is a consumer-facing support commitment of the same nature as security support.

fields.label: Hazardous Materials Identified
fields.definition: Materials or components found in the item that require selective treatment before bulk processing.
fields.tier_rationale: Selective-treatment findings (Dir. 2012/19/EU Annex VII) are addressed to treatment operators; the consumer-facing substance summary lives in the RoHS and substance-of-concern fields.

fields.label: Hazardous Waste Record
fields.definition: The hazardous waste consignment arising from this operation.
fields.tier_rationale: Hazardous waste consignment records are regulatory documentation held between the operator and the competent authority (Dir. 2008/98/EC).

fields.label: Installed Component Passport
fields.definition: The component fitted into the device, referenced by the identifier its own Digital Product Passport is keyed on.
fields.tier_rationale: Links into component passports expose the component supply chain, matching the tier of euelec:hasComponentPassport.

fields.label: Material Declaration
fields.tier_rationale: The IEC 62474 declaration is detailed substance composition communicated through the professional supply chain per REACH Art. 33(1); the consumer-facing hazard summary lives in public SoC fields.

fields.label: Material Recovery Results
fields.definition: Measured outcome of the treatment operation on this item.
fields.tier_rationale: Achieved per-item recovery figures are reported to producer-responsibility schemes and authorities against the Dir. 2012/19/EU Annex V targets; the public tier carries the design-level rates.

fields.label: Peak Brightness
fields.definition: Peak brightness in candelas per square meter (nits). Use gs1:QuantitativeValue. Use unitCode 'CDM2' (UN/CEFACT Rec 20).
fields.tier_rationale: Peak brightness is ordinary public spec-sheet information also used in the public energy-label calculation for displays.

fields.label: hasPowerConsumptionOff
fields.tier_rationale: Off-mode power is product-information-sheet data of the energy-labelling framework, public where a delegated act applies; aligned with core oec:hasPowerConsumptionOff (Public).

fields.label: hasPowerConsumptionOn
fields.tier_rationale: On-mode power is product-information-sheet data of the energy-labelling framework, public where a delegated act applies; aligned with core oec:hasPowerConsumptionOn (Public).

fields.label: hasPowerConsumptionStandby
fields.tier_rationale: Standby power is product-information-sheet data of the energy-labelling framework, public where a delegated act applies; aligned with core oec:hasPowerConsumptionStandby (Public).

fields.label: Recycling Facility
fields.definition: The authorised treatment operator that carried out the recycling step.
fields.tier_rationale: Which authorised operator treated one item is supply-chain detail for schemes and authorities; the facility's own master data is resolver-served under its GLN.

fields.label: Refresh Rate
fields.definition: Display refresh rate. Use gs1:QuantitativeValue with unitCode 'HTZ'.
fields.tier_rationale: Refresh rate is ordinary public spec-sheet information.

fields.label: Repair Cost
fields.definition: Amount charged to the owner for this repair. Zero where the repair was covered by a warranty.
fields.tier_rationale: What one repair actually cost is transaction data; the publicly required figure is the spare-part price (euelec:hasSparePartPrice, Public).

fields.label: Repairability Index
fields.definition: French Repairability Index (Indice de Réparabilité) assessment.
fields.tier_rationale: The repairability index is a consumer-facing point-of-sale label (French Indice de Reparabilite; ESPR Annex I repairability).

fields.label: Replaced Component Passport
fields.definition: The component taken out of the device, referenced by the identifier its own Digital Product Passport is keyed on.
fields.tier_rationale: Links into component passports expose the component supply chain, matching the tier of euelec:hasComponentPassport.

fields.label: Replacement Difficulty
fields.definition: Level of difficulty to replace this component.
fields.tier_rationale: Replacement difficulty is consumer repair information that informs the repair-or-replace decision.

fields.label: RoHS Compliance
fields.definition: RoHS Directive compliance information.
fields.tier_rationale: RoHS conformity information backs the CE marking, a public conformity claim (Dir. 2011/65/EU).

fields.label: Screen Diagonal
fields.definition: Visible screen diagonal. Use gs1:QuantitativeValue with unitCode 'CMT' or 'INH'.
fields.tier_rationale: Screen diagonal appears on the public energy label for displays (Reg. (EU) 2019/2013).

fields.label: Security Support Years
fields.definition: Number of years of security update support. Use gs1:QuantitativeValue with unitCode 'ANN'.
fields.tier_rationale: The guaranteed security-update period is a purchase-decision commitment (Reg. (EU) 2023/1670 requires 5 years of OS/security updates).

fields.label: Software Support
fields.definition: Software and firmware support information.
fields.tier_rationale: The software-support container carries update-horizon commitments that Reg. (EU) 2023/1670 makes consumer-facing.

fields.label: Software Update Event
fields.tier_rationale: The raw per-device update event log is operational lifecycle data for service and surveillance actors; the public tier carries the aggregated support-status fields instead.

fields.label: Spare Part Availability Years
fields.definition: Duration for which this component is available as a spare part. Use unitCode 'ANN' (UN/CEFACT Rec 20).
fields.tier_rationale: Spare-part availability periods are consumer information that Reg. (EU) 2023/1670 requires to be made publicly available for smartphones/tablets.

fields.label: Spare Part Price
fields.definition: Price of the component as a spare part.
fields.tier_rationale: Spare-part pricing is consumer repair-decision information that Reg. (EU) 2023/1670 requires professional repairers and end-users to be able to see.

fields.label: WEEE Compliance
fields.definition: WEEE Directive compliance information.
fields.tier_rationale: The WEEE-compliance container carries user-facing collection and recyclability information (Dir. 2012/19/EU Art. 14); producer-registration specifics inside it are tiered separately.

fields.label: Hazardous Waste Generated
fields.definition: Whether the operation produced hazardous waste.
fields.tier_rationale: Whether hazardous waste arose is waste-classification data under Dir. 2008/98/EC, addressed to operators and authorities.

fields.label: IEC 62474 DSL Version
fields.definition: Version of the IEC 62474 Declarable Substance List used.
fields.tier_rationale: The declarable-substance-list version is methodology metadata of the professional material declaration.

fields.label: Is Replaceable
fields.definition: Whether the component can be replaced.
fields.tier_rationale: Component replaceability is consumer repair information (ESPR Annex I; smartphone/tablet ecodesign requires replaceable parts).

fields.label: Latest Update Date
fields.definition: Date of the most recent software/firmware update.
fields.tier_rationale: The date of the latest update shows whether the public support commitment is being honoured.

fields.label: Material Declaration Date
fields.definition: Date of the material declaration.
fields.tier_rationale: The declaration date is administrative detail of the professional material declaration.

fields.label: Next Disposition
fields.definition: The intended onward route for the removed component after this event.
fields.tier_rationale: The intended onward route of a removed part is treatment-chain planning data (Dir. 2012/19/EU Art. 8).

fields.label: OS Version
fields.definition: Current version of the operating system.
fields.tier_rationale: The current OS version is device-state transparency a user can read from the device itself.

fields.label: Recycling Process
fields.definition: The treatment or recycling process applied to the item.
fields.tier_rationale: The applied treatment process is operator process data (Dir. 2012/19/EU Art. 8 and Annex VIII).

fields.label: Removal Reason
fields.definition: Why the component was removed from the device.
fields.tier_rationale: Why a part failed on one device is service-history and failure-analysis data; the public tier carries the aggregate durability and repairability figures.

fields.label: Repair Description
fields.definition: Description of the repair performed and the fault it addressed.
fields.tier_rationale: The repair narrative is service-history detail of one device.

fields.label: Repair Technician
fields.definition: The technician or service organisation that performed the repair, as recorded on the repair event.
fields.tier_rationale: Naming who performed a repair identifies a service party in a specific transaction; the public tier carries the published repair network (oec:RepairProvider).

fields.label: Repair Type
fields.definition: The kind of repair performed (battery replacement, display replacement, board-level repair, ...).
fields.tier_rationale: What was repaired on one device is service-history data for repairers, owners and surveillance actors, not a public product attribute.

fields.label: Repairability Label URL
fields.definition: URL to the official repairability label image.
fields.tier_rationale: The repairability label image is a public consumer label.

fields.label: RoHS Compliant
fields.definition: Whether the device complies with RoHS Directive.
fields.tier_rationale: The RoHS pass/fail status is a public conformity claim expressed by the CE marking (Dir. 2011/65/EU).

fields.label: RoHS Declaration URL
fields.definition: URL to the RoHS compliance declaration document.
fields.tier_rationale: The RoHS declaration document is the published substantiation of the public conformity claim.

fields.label: RoHS Exemptions
fields.definition: List of applicable RoHS exemption codes (e.g., '7(a)', '7(c)-I').
fields.tier_rationale: Claimed RoHS exemptions (Annex III/IV codes) qualify the public conformity claim and are themselves published lists.

fields.label: Screen Resolution Height
fields.definition: Vertical resolution in pixels.
fields.tier_rationale: Screen resolution appears on the public energy label and fiche for displays (Reg. (EU) 2019/2013).

fields.label: Screen Resolution Width
fields.definition: Horizontal resolution in pixels.
fields.tier_rationale: Screen resolution appears on the public energy label and fiche for displays (Reg. (EU) 2019/2013).

fields.label: Security Update End Date
fields.definition: Date until which security updates will be provided.
fields.tier_rationale: The security-update end date is the concrete form of the public update-support commitment.

fields.label: Sorting Decision
fields.definition: Outcome of the sorting or inspection step: which treatment route the item was directed to, and why.
fields.tier_rationale: The routing decision taken at a sorting facility is operational treatment data (Dir. 2012/19/EU Art. 8).

fields.label: Update Channel
fields.definition: URL or method for obtaining software updates (OTA, website, etc.).
fields.tier_rationale: How to obtain updates is consumer use information required for the update commitment to be actionable.

fields.label: Warranty Status
fields.definition: Whether the device was under warranty at the time of the event.
fields.tier_rationale: Whether one item was in warranty at the time of a repair is a commercial fact between owner, seller and repairer; the warranty terms themselves are model master data.

fields.label: weeeRegistrationCountry
fields.tier_rationale: The registration country is EPR administration detail accompanying the producer registration number.

fields.label: weeeRegistrationNumber
fields.tier_rationale: The producer registration number (Dir. 2012/19/EU Art. 16) is EPR administration data for registers and authorities, not consumer information.
